mission_result: The binding critic policy already names the right event classes, but it was not yet an operational scheduling contract because it lacked a deterministic lifecycle, trigger coalescing/dedup identity, reset semantics, independence tests, anti-recursion rules, and an explicit Planner disposition boundary. This return supplies that candidate contract without promoting it as runtime behavior. A critic is operational only when durable trigger evidence creates one independent critic lifecycle, its immutable RETURN is dispositioned by a different planning actor, and the next Planner receipt shows an evidence-linked route/gate/DAG effect or an explicit evidence-based rejection/no-change disposition.

checkpoint_completion.finding: Defined ARMED -> TRIGGER_PENDING -> CLAIMED -> RETURNED_PENDING_DISPOSITION -> RECONCILED -> ARMED with deterministic trigger identity, coalescing and reset semantics.
Defined worker/decision-actor separation, durable-evidence boot requirements, fresh epoch/head reads and same-worker disposition prohibition.
Defined one-live-strategic-critic-per-frontier slot, trigger coalescing, no critic-return self-trigger, stale retry through recovery, and backstop reset only after reconciliation.
Mapped critic RETURNs into the typed integration-disposition ledger and defined route-effect/no-change evidence plus ritual-summary falsifiers.

evidence.observed: Binding policy requires event-driven critics plus a 10-durable-RETURN backstop, fresh independent criticism, current receipts/metrics, and reconciliation of findings rather than critic prose alone.
Binding meta-method requires fresh critics for authority/architecture/downstream/evidence-conflict/drift/throughput triggers and requires Planner route comparison rather than newest-detail drift.

Snapshot explicitly records critic cadence/progress compiler as non-operational and shows the 10-return backstop false in that measurement window; therefore policy existence cannot be promoted as runtime use.

Current replayable planning boundary already supports CONSUMED/DEFERRED/CONFLICTED/REJECTED_WITH_REASON/NOT_APPLICABLE, explicit PENDING_UNREAD, immutable RETURN refs and same-worker consumption prohibition.

operational_scheduling_contract.unit_of_scheduling: one strategic critic lifecycle per deterministic frontier slot; multiple trigger reasons may coalesce into that lifecycle

transitions.when: at least one trigger predicate is proven by durable evidence and no equivalent live critic slot exists
an independent worker wins exclusive create-if-absent claim
a different planning/integration actor records explicit scope dispositions for every material finding
the reconciliation receipt is durable; counters/watermarks advance to the reconciled cutoff rather than merely to critic RETURN time

trigger_predicates.notes: Count durable worker RETURNs, never chat count. Do not reset on critic STARTED or RETURNED; reset only after RECONCILED.

trigger_predicates.predicate: a generation has a durable terminal generation receipt/output and its critic_trigger_decision has not already been reconciled for that generation
a candidate architecture/method is proposed for a higher authority/truth layer
the declared compounding/progress metric fails to improve across two comparable generation receipts, with missing measurement represented as UNKNOWN rather than improvement
two or more durable incident/correction records identify the same drift/under-ambition phenotype after the prior corrective disposition
prepared + dynamically-ready compatible work drains while the governing stage gate remains unchanged and no valid boundary explains the stall
same normalized blocker_id remains unresolved across two durable planning-cycle receipts
(stale + failed + boundary claims) / claims_started > 0.20 for the generation, with denominator and classification receipts explicit
Context Fabric, Planner, Steward, claim/allocation, stale recovery or authority behavior changes materially enough to invalidate prior critic evidence
a parent/Planner proposes waiting while exact evidence proves independent compatible safe work is available

dedup_and_coalescing.one_live_slot_rule: At most one CLAIMED/STARTED strategic critic for the same frontier_key. New trigger classes while that slot is live append/coalesce as pending trigger evidence for reconciliation; they do not spawn another equivalent critic.
dedup_and_coalescing.new_critic_allowed_when: the prior slot is RECONCILED and new evidence is beyond its watermarks, or the prior run is recovery-eligible under the stale protocol
dedup_and_coalescing.collision_rule: create-if-absent loss means consume the winner; never duplicate the same slot

freshness_and_independence.critic_worker_separation: critic_worker_instance_id must differ from the Planner/parent worker instance whose route is being evaluated
freshness_and_independence.decision_actor_separation: the actor dispositioning a critic RETURN must differ from the critic producer; this matches the current integration-disposition invariant forbidding same-worker CONSUMED
freshness_and_independence.fresh_boot_requirement: critic must boot from current durable state: latest epoch/head, relevant receipts/metrics, exact returns/incidents/generation output and binding north-star/meta-method; inherited chat prose alone is insufficient
freshness_and_independence.evidence_requirement: at least one runtime/receipt/metric/evidence source beyond architecture prose is mandatory
freshness_and_independence.freshness_cutoff: critic receipt records source_head_cutoff and epoch; findings about live readiness must be revalidated if relevant dependencies changed before Planner consumption
freshness_and_independence.model_independence: different model vendor/family is not required by this contract; cognitive independence is established by separate worker identity, fresh durable-context reconstruction and decision-actor separation

anti_recursion_and_spam.critic_return_is_not_trigger: a critic RETURN by itself cannot trigger another strategic critic; it enters Planner/Steward disposition first
anti_recursion_and_spam.no_trigger_on_unread_finding: PENDING_UNREAD critic findings cannot be treated as adopted and cannot recursively create another critic slot
anti_recursion_and_spam.retry_rule: a stalled critic is recovered through append-only stale recovery linked to previous_run, not by firing a new strategic trigger
anti_recursion_and_spam.coalesce_rule: multiple predicates proven before or during one live critic become trigger reasons/evidence for that critic or its reconciliation, not parallel equivalent critics
anti_recursion_and_spam.backstop_reset_rule: 10-return counter resets at RECONCILED watermark, not at claim/start/return
anti_recursion_and_spam.technical_critic_parallelism: independent technical/surface critics may coexist only when their semantic target/slot differs and write scopes do not collide
anti_recursion_and_spam.loop_breaker: critic recommendations may create Planner inputs/opportunities, but any future strategic critic must be justified by a new trigger predicate with evidence after the prior reconciliation watermark

planner_handoff.ingest_rule: critic RETURN stays immutable and is referenced by content hash in a planning integration-disposition ledger
planner_handoff.pending_rule: missing decision remains PENDING_UNREAD and the critic lifecycle is not RECONCILED
planner_handoff.per_finding_scope: material findings should receive stable finding_id/scope_id so partial adoption/conflict is representable without whole-return newest-wins behavior
planner_handoff.consumed_effect_requirement: CONSUMED must point to a later Planner/generation receipt showing the route, dependency DAG, gate, opportunity set, stop-doing rule or verification criterion affected
planner_handoff.explicit_no_change: A critic may be valuable without route mutation only if the Planner disposition cites decisive evidence that falsifies the proposed alternative or confirms the current route against the critic's falsifier; generic 'already considered' is insufficient
planner_handoff.generation_receipt_requirement: Planner strategic receipt records critic trigger decision, critic return refs consumed, dispositions and next-generation effect

counts_as_route_effecting_value_if_any: a blocker/gate is newly discovered, invalidated or sharpened with evidence
an alternative route changes priority/rank or an opportunity is inserted/removed/re-scoped
a dependency, authority or verification condition is materially changed
a previously claimed capability is downgraded because use evidence is absent
an explicit NO_CHANGE disposition defeats the critic's alternative using stronger evidence and a falsifiable reason
ritual_summary_fail_if_all: findings only restate existing architecture/queue labels
no alternative or current-route falsifier is specified
no Planner-visible delta, blocker, stop/deprioritize rule or evidence-based no-change test is produced
critic_value_and_ritual_falsifiers.degradation_signal: If three consecutive reconciled strategic critics yield zero route-effecting value and zero evidence-based no-change falsification value, create a Planner/verification incident to reassess trigger specificity before increasing critic frequency.

current_truth_assessment.reason: The repository has binding trigger policy and this operational contract candidate, but no evidence in this recovery task that a persistent runtime state machine is automatically evaluating predicates, coalescing triggers, dispatching critics and persisting reconciliation watermarks without guide/manual orchestration.
current_truth_assessment.promotion_bar: Require at least one real trigger -> independent claim/STARTED -> critic RETURN -> typed disposition by different actor -> Planner receipt effect cycle, plus one coalescing/backstop or stale-recovery case before calling critic cadence operational.
